attributes.action: Restrict the sale and use of fireworks to organized public displays only
attributes.additional_details:
Every year, the unregulated use of fireworks in domestic gardens causes severe distress to domestic pets, livestock, and wildlife, while exacerbating health conditions for vulnerable individuals, such as those with PTSD or sensory processing disorders.
 Restricting fireworks to organized, professionally managed public displays will ensure public safety, protect animal welfare, and allow communities to enjoy displays responsibly within controlled environments.
attributes.background: Amend the Fireworks Regulations 2004 and the Fireworks Act 2003 to ban the sale of fireworks to the general public, outlaw the use of fireworks in private gardens, and restrict all firework usage strictly to licensed, pre-planned, or organized public events.

rejection.details:
We have just opened a petition on the subject of banning private sale and use of fireworks, so they can be used only at licensed displays. You may wish to sign this.
